# /verify - prove the task works, then open the PR

## When to run
- **Before opening a PR** - this is the gate; the PR carries the proof it produces.
- **On explicit request** - "verify this", "does this actually work", "prove it".

You are the **orchestrator + fixer**. Verification splits by who's best at it:

- **The subjective question - "does the task I just built do what was intended?"**
  -> delegate to a fresh **verifier sub-agent** that drives the built CLI and judges
  it. Independence (it didn't write the code) + context-isolation pay off. Most
  tasks have no spec - **agentic verification, not "run the test."** Do it first.
- **Objective, codified checks** (gofmt, vet/skill drift, unit suite) -> **you**
  run them, after, as a regression sweep. Pass/fail can't be rubber-stamped, and
  you need the error to fix it.

## Repo specifics (filled in by `verifier-setup`)
- **Stack** - build the CLI with: `make build` (produces `./bin/no-mistakes`)
- **Where the app runs** - it is a CLI; drive `./bin/no-mistakes <subcommand>` directly. There is no server or URL.
- **Run mode** - **local** (built in this worktree; no sandbox)
- **Driver** - `./bin/no-mistakes` (the built binary from `make build`)
- **Auth** - n/a
- **Evidence** - write all proof to `evidence/` (gitignored)
- **Proof upload target** - `gh release upload pr-evidence <files> --clobber` against a `pr-evidence` prerelease on this repo, then link the release asset URLs in the PR body
- **Never touch the shared daemon** - `~/.no-mistakes` is the live service home for every lane. Always run the CLI under a scratch home: `NM_HOME=$(mktemp -d) ./bin/no-mistakes ...`. Never run `daemon stop`/`daemon restart`/`update`.

## 0. Preconditions
On a branch, not the default branch; changes committed.

## 1. Build the stack - once
`make build` - you own it; the verifier reuses the binary.

## 2. Verify the TASK (delegate) -> fix -> re-verify (loop)
Brief from the task/plan file if one exists (point the verifier at it), else pass
the acceptance criteria inline. Spawn a read-only verifier:

```
You are a read-only verifier. Do NOT edit code. Independently confirm THIS task
works by driving the built CLI (already built at ./bin/no-mistakes). It likely has
no automated spec - verify it agentically.

TASK (what a user should now be able to do, and the observable success state):
  <intent / acceptance criteria>          (or: see task/plan file <path>)
HOW TO EXERCISE IT:
  Run the built binary in a scratch home and a scratch git repo under /tmp:
  NM_HOME=$(mktemp -d) ./bin/no-mistakes <subcommands>. Use `--help` to find the
  surface the task touched, then walk the real user flow (init, axi, doctor, ...).
  Assert on stdout/stderr text and exit codes. NEVER point it at ~/.no-mistakes
  and never run daemon stop/restart/update.
DRIVER:
  ./bin/no-mistakes (Go CLI; no browser needed)
AUTH:
  n/a

Walk the exact steps, capture the success state to evidence/ (command + full
output + exit code per step, as .txt), and judge observed vs expected. Return ONLY:

TASK: works | broken
  expected: <criteria>
  observed: <what actually happened>
  evidence: <paths under evidence/>
```

- **broken** -> fix the implementation, then spawn a **fresh** verifier. You never
  declare the task works yourself.
- Cap at ~3 rounds; if still broken, escalate to the human with the verdict.

## 3. Regression sweep - you run the codified checks; fix red directly
```
gofmt -l .        # must print nothing
make lint         # generated-skill drift + go vet
go test -race ./...
```
Triage failures (real-bug vs stale-test); never weaken an assertion to go green.
If a fix here changes task behavior, re-verify (step 2). Run `make e2e` instead
of the unit sweep when the task touched agent integrations, the e2e harness, or
recorded fixtures.

## 4. Open the PR - lead with the proof, embed the evidence
The PR body MUST show the evidence, not just mention it. Upload the evidence
files to the stable target (`EVIDENCE_UPLOAD` above), then in the body paste the
exercise commands with the tail of their real output.

```markdown
## What changed
<1-3 lines>

## Task verified (verifier drove the CLI)
- <acceptance criteria> - observed working.
  $ NM_HOME=$(mktemp -d) ./bin/no-mistakes <cmd>
  <tail of real output>

## Regression guardrails
- [x] gofmt -l . (clean) / make lint / go test -race ./...

## How to reproduce
make build && NM_HOME=$(mktemp -d) ./bin/no-mistakes <exercise steps>
```

## Rules
- **The task is the verdict** - a green suite with an unverified task isn't done.
- **"Does it actually work" -> an independent verifier; objective checks -> you.**
- Never open a PR until the task is verified. **Proof, not claims.** Branch -> PR only.
